en.name: Imperialist
en.ability: If a player is mad about being executed, they may be executed.

revisions.v1: If a player is mad about being executed, they may be executed.
revisions.v2: On your first night, choose to live or to die. If a player is mad about that, they may be executed.

revisions.v1: “疯狂”地想要死亡的玩家可能会立即被处决。
revisions.v2: 在你的首个夜晚，你要选择存活或死亡。“疯狂”地想要这样做的玩家可能会立即被处决。
